name: Inquisitor's Flail
blocked_sentences: If equipped creature would deal combat damage, it deals double that damage instead.
If another creature would deal combat damage to equipped creature, it deals double that damage to equipped creature instead.

needs.what: A permanent-level static effect that multiplies damage as a replacement (615/616), in both directions, with a filter on each side. Concretely a `static_effects` entry -- e.g. `replace_damage` -- carrying `damage_multiplier: 2` plus two optional `static_filter_keys` filters: a source filter ("if <this source> would deal damage", here `{"attached": true}` for the equipped creature) and a recipient filter ("...to <this object>", again `{"attached": true}`), and a `combat_only: true` switch because this card doubles combat damage only while Furnace of Rath and Gratuitous Violence double all damage. It has to be read inside `damage_player` and `damage_permanent` in `src/automtg/engine/primitives.py` (the same places `protected_from` and `prevented_damage` are consulted), after prevention and before the damage is marked, so that lifelink, deathtouch, infect, the DAMAGE_DEALT ledger and commander-damage tallies all see the doubled number -- which is what makes it a replacement and not a trigger. The same one capability closes Furnace of Rath, Dictate of the Twin Gods, Gratuitous Violence, Angrath's Marauders and Fiery Emancipation (x3).
needs.why_existing_wont_do: No damage-modifying static exists at all. The multiplier replacements the engine has are life and card economy only -- `replace_life_gain` (`gain_multiplier`), `replace_life_loss` (`loss_multiplier`), `replace_draw` (`draw_multiplier`), `replace_mill` (`mill_multiplier`) and `replace_token_creation` (`token_multiplier`); all five are PLAYER-wide statics resolved in `engine/player_statics.py` keyed by player id, so none of them can be attached to a permanent, filtered by source or recipient, or reach combat damage. `replace_life_loss` is the nearest miss and is genuinely wrong here: damage is not life loss (it is marked on creatures, feeds deathtouch and infect, and only incidentally reduces a player's life), so doubling the loss would leave a doubled hit on a creature undoubled and would also double non-damage life loss. The only damage-facing statics are `prevent_damage` and `protection`, which subtract or forbid and have no way to add; `src/automtg/engine/primitives.py` `damage_player`/`damage_permanent` consult `shielded`, `protected_from` and `prevented_damage` and then mark `amount` unchanged, so there is no hook on the damage path where an increase could be applied. `double_triggers` and `double_land_triggers` double triggered abilities, not damage, and the `damage` op multiplies nothing and would in any case be a one-shot effect rather than a continuous replacement. Nothing in `ops` can approximate this without changing the card: a `dealt_damage` or `deals_combat_damage_to_player` trigger that deals the damage again resolves from the stack after state-based actions, so a doubled lethal hit would kill the creature once and then shoot a dead object, first strike and deathtouch would be scored on the printed number, and the redundant damage would come from the Flail rather than from the creature.
